_comment: MCP tools/list result of the Jarvis helmet as the server receives it (firmware v2.5.0 + board jarvis-helmet). Order = firmware order: AddCommonTools() first, then helmet_tools::Register, MaskController, OutputController. User-only tools (self.servo.*) are not in "tools" (the server never asks for them); "userOnlyTools" keeps them for tools/tests/e2e/device_sim.py, which builds its tool list from this file. Property JSON follows McpServer Property::to_json (no per-property descriptions). Kept in sync with firmware/main/boards/jarvis-helmet/*.cc by test_run_tool_calls.py. A real capture (e.g. from tools/tests/e2e/device_sim.py or a device log) can replace this file via --device-tools.

tools.name: self.get_device_status
tools.description:
Provides the real-time information of the device, including the current status of the audio speaker, screen, battery, network, etc.
Use this tool for: 
1. Answering questions about current condition (e.g. what is the current volume of the audio speaker?)
2. As the first step to control the device (e.g. turn up / down the volume of the audio speaker, etc.)

tools.name: self.audio_speaker.set_volume
tools.description: Set the volume of the audio speaker. If the current volume is unknown, you must call `self.get_device_status` tool first and then call this tool.

tools.name: self.screen.set_brightness
tools.description: Set the brightness of the screen.

tools.name: self.screen.set_theme
tools.description: Set the theme of the screen. The theme can be `light` or `dark`.

tools.name: self.sequence.run
tools.description: Chạy chuỗi thao tác / Run a step sequence. steps = JSON array of one-key objects: mask, servo, eyes, output, delay, display, sound. Returns at once; a new sequence replaces the running one.

tools.name: self.sequence.run_saved
tools.description: Chạy chuỗi đã lưu / Run a sequence saved on the helmet by name (e.g. open_mask, close_mask).

tools.name: self.sequence.save
tools.description: Lưu chuỗi thao tác vào mũ / Save a step sequence on the helmet for offline use (name: a-z, 0-9, _; max 11 chars).

tools.name: self.sequence.stop
tools.description: Dừng chuỗi đang chạy / Stop the running sequence.

tools.name: self.display.show_info
tools.description: Hiện thẻ thông tin trên HUD / Show an info card on the helmet HUD (title max 24 chars, text max 200 chars).

tools.name: self.system.get_status
tools.description: Trạng thái mũ / Helmet status: mask, eyes, output, running sequence, 5V supply (vbus_mv), Wi-Fi RSSI, uptime.

tools.name: self.mask.open
tools.description: Mở mặt nạ (nâng tấm che mặt lên). / Open (raise) the helmet faceplate. Returns at once, the motion runs in the background.

tools.name: self.mask.close
tools.description: Đóng mặt nạ (hạ tấm che mặt xuống). / Close (lower) the helmet faceplate. Returns at once, the motion runs in the background.

tools.name: self.mask.set_position
tools.description: Mở mặt nạ một phần. / Move the faceplate to a partial position: percent 0 = closed, 100 = fully open.

tools.name: self.mask.get_state
tools.description: Xem trạng thái mặt nạ. / Get the faceplate state: open, closed or moving, with position 0-100 (0 = closed).

tools.name: self.eyes.set
tools.description: Bật/tắt đèn mắt, chỉnh độ sáng. / Turn the eye lights on or off and set their brightness 0-100.

tools.name: self.eyes.effect
tools.description: Hiệu ứng đèn mắt. / Eye light effect: breathe (repeats until another command, duration_ms = cycle), blink, flicker, power_up (light up), fade_out (dim to off). duration_ms 0 = default (breathe 2500, flicker 600, others 1000).

tools.name: self.output.set
tools.description: Bật/tắt ngõ ra phụ (kênh dự phòng). / Switch the auxiliary spare output on or off.

userOnlyTools.name: self.servo.calibrate
userOnlyTools.description: Hiệu chỉnh: quay một servo tới góc thô. / Calibration: drive one servo (0 = left, 1 = right) to a raw angle 0-180 without the calibrated limits.

userOnlyTools.name: self.servo.save_calibration
userOnlyTools.description: Lưu góc đóng/mở của một servo. / Save one servo's closed and open angles (0-180, must differ). Used for every later mask move.
